visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A bald man in a black t-shirt is standing indoors in front of a light wooden door. An interviewer's hand holds a white and yellow microphone with the logo 'HahaTai' towards him. The interviewer is partially visible on the left wearing a grey shirt and glasses. The lighting is bright and even. (2) The man bows his head slightly while the interviewer points a finger at his scalp. The camera zooms in to provide a macro close-up of the man's scalp, revealing thousands of tiny tattooed dots designed to mimic the appearance of a buzz cut. (3) The man stands straight again and continues talking, using animated hand gestures and pointing to his head. He smiles and maintains eye contact with the interviewer. (4) The man continues his story, occasionally touching his head. The camera cuts between his face and the interviewer's reaction. (5) The shot cuts to the two interviewers laughing heartily; one is seen from the side profile. The video ends with a close-up of the bald man smiling back at them.
